Nothing is charged when you subscribe: your card is first charged on the day of your first visit, for a full month, then every month on that date. terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.accept: I have read and accept the terms
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use MISK to book home and garden services or to offer them as a pro. Please read them before you create an account.

conduct.title: 9. Code of conduct for pros
conduct.body: Arrive on time and tell the customer in the app if you run late. Treat customers, their homes and their belongings with respect, and do only the work that was booked or that the customer approved in the app. Keep every payment in the app: never ask a customer to pay you directly. Use customers' addresses and details only for the job. Never work under the influence of alcohol or drugs. If something is unsafe, stop and report an issue in the app. Breaking these rules can lead to a quality check, a pause of new jobs or the end of your account.

proCancelling.title: 10. Cancellation rules for pros
proCancelling.body: You can give back a job you accepted from the job screen. More than 24 hours before the start there is no penalty, but the job counts as not accepted in your acceptance rate. Less than 24 hours before the start it is a late cancellation: 3 late cancellations within 30 days pause new job offers for a week. If the customer is not home, report it in the app and wait 15 minutes; you can then leave and are paid the call-out fee. If a customer cancels late, you are paid your share.

about.title: 1. What MISK is
about.body: MISK is a marketplace that connects customers with independent professionals ("pros") for home and garden services. The pros are not employed by MISK; each pro is responsible for the work they do.

account.title: 2. Your account
account.body: Give your real name and an email address or mobile number you use. An email account can only sign in after you confirm your email address. Keep your password to yourself. We may pause or close an account that breaks these terms or is used to harm others.

booking.title: 3. Booking and prices
booking.body: The price you see before you book includes VAT and the MISK service fee. Your card is checked when you book, and charged 24 hours after the pro marks the job as done.

cancelling.title: 4. Cancelling
cancelling.body: You can cancel for free until 24 hours before the start. If you cancel later and a pro has already been assigned, the full price is charged and the pro is paid their share.

problems.title: 5. If something goes wrong
problems.body: Report a problem in the app within 24 hours after the job. The charge then waits until our team has looked at it. Depending on what happened, the team refunds you or charges the booking.

tips.title: 6. Tips
tips.body: Tips are optional and charged to the card you booked with. The pro receives the tip minus the same commission MISK keeps on jobs. A refund of a job does not refund a tip.

plans.title: 7. Monthly plans
plans.body: Plans are billed every month, from the day of your first visit: nothing is charged when you subscribe (unless your first visit is tomorrow). Once its minimum term is over, you can cancel a plan in the app with 30 days' notice; visits until it ends still take place and are charged. You can move a single visit to another day of the same week if your pro confirms. Seasonal plans only run from April to October.

pros.title: 8. For pros
pros.body: Pros send their ID card or passport, liability insurance and, for trades that need one, a trade certificate, and agree to a background check. They get jobs only once MISK has checked them and while their documents stay valid; a trade added later is checked before it brings jobs. MISK keeps a commission on each job and tip and pays the rest to the pro's bank account on the payout schedule MISK sets, once the customer's 24 hours to report a problem have passed.

liability.title: 11. Responsibility
liability.body: MISK is responsible for running the platform and handling payments with care. The pro who does the job is responsible for the quality and safety of the work. Nothing in these terms limits your rights as a consumer under the law.

changes.title: 12. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. If a change matters for you, we tell you in the app or by email before it applies.
